related.title: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有相位辨識與速度假設清楚時報告模型距離；不可用單一到時差宣稱完整三維位置。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Report model distance only with clear phase identification and speed assumptions; one time difference cannot establish a full 3-D location. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 由地面移動速度與曝光時間估算拖影，與像素尺度分開評估。
related.differenceEn: Estimate motion smear from ground speed and exposure, separately from pixel scale.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成 P 波速 6 km/s、S 波速 3.5 km/s，到時差 50 s。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：d=50/(1/3.5−1/6)。 結果約 420 km。均勻直線路徑下 Δt=d(1/vS−1/vP)；分層行星、反射相與誤認相不適用。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學地面速率 3000 m/s、曝光 0.0001 s、地面像素 0.3 m。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：b=3000×0.0001/0.3。 結果約 1 pixel。固定視向且無補償時拖影像素數=v地面×t曝光/GSD；假設局部速度固定。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic P speed is 6 km/s, S speed 3.5 km/s and arrival difference 50 s. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: d=50/(1/3.5−1/6). Result ≈ 420 km. For a uniform straight path, Δt=d(1/vS−1/vP); layered structure, reflected phases and misidentification violate the model.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching ground speed 3000 m/s, exposure 0.0001 s and 0.3 m ground sample distance. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: b=3000×0.0001/0.3. Result ≈ 1 pixel. Without image-motion compensation, smear pixels=ground speed×exposure/GSD, assuming constant local speed.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Psyche 小行星探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有相位辨識與速度假設清楚時報告模型距離；不可用單一到時差宣稱完整三維位置。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Report model distance only with clear phase identification and speed assumptions; one time difference cannot establish a full 3-D location. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 用質量與形狀模型估算平均密度，分析半徑誤差如何放大。
related.differenceEn: Estimate bulk density from mass and shape, analyzing amplification of radius error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成 P 波速 6 km/s、S 波速 3.5 km/s，到時差 50 s。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：d=50/(1/3.5−1/6)。 結果約 420 km。均勻直線路徑下 Δt=d(1/vS−1/vP)；分層行星、反射相與誤認相不適用。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成質量 2×10¹⁹ kg、等效半徑 100 km，先換為公尺。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：ρ=2×10¹⁹/(4π×100000³/3)。 結果約 4774.65 kg/m³。球形教學模型 ρ=M/(4πr³/3)；真實不規則體應用網格體積，孔隙率造成成分歧義。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic P speed is 6 km/s, S speed 3.5 km/s and arrival difference 50 s. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: d=50/(1/3.5−1/6). Result ≈ 420 km. For a uniform straight path, Δt=d(1/vS−1/vP); layered structure, reflected phases and misidentification violate the model.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use synthetic mass 2×10¹⁹ kg and equivalent radius 100 km, converted to meters. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: ρ=2×10¹⁹/(4π×100000³/3). Result ≈ 4774.65 kg/m³. The spherical teaching model is ρ=M/(4πr³/3); a real irregular body needs mesh volume and porosity complicates composition.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
